Class FaceppFaceOperations

java.lang.Object
com.faceplusplus.spring.boot.FaceppOperations
com.faceplusplus.spring.boot.FaceppFaceOperations
Direct Known Subclasses:
FaceppFaceAsyncOperations
public class FaceppFaceOperations extends FaceppOperations
Synchronous operations for the Face++ face recognition API group. Provides methods for face detection, analysis, comparison, search, and skin analysis.
Since:
3.0.0
Author:
[@Loong Wan](https://github.com/loong10k)

    • detectUrl

      public FaceDetectResponse detectUrl(String imageUrl, FaceDetectOptions options) throws IOException
      Detects faces in an image specified by URL. Returns face tokens and optional attributes/landmarks for each detected face.
      Parameters:
      imageUrl - the URL of the image to analyze
      options - optional detection parameters (landmark, attributes, etc.)
      Returns:
      the detection response containing face tokens and metadata
      Throws:
      IOException - if the HTTP request fails
      See Also:
      • FaceppApiAddress.FACE_DETECT

    • analyze

      public FaceAnalyzeResponse analyze(String[] faceTokens, FaceAnalyzeOptions options) throws IOException
      Analyzes facial attributes and landmarks for one or more face tokens. A single call supports up to 5 face tokens.
      Parameters:
      faceTokens - array of face token strings (max 5)
      options - optional analysis parameters
      Returns:
      the analysis response containing facial attributes and landmarks
      Throws:
      IOException - if the HTTP request fails
      See Also:
      • FaceppApiAddress.FACE_ANALYZE

    • compareUrl

      public FaceCompareResponse compareUrl(String imageUrl1, String imageUrl2) throws IOException
      Compares two faces specified by image URLs. Returns a confidence score indicating the likelihood that the two faces belong to the same person.
      Parameters:
      imageUrl1 - the URL of the first image
      imageUrl2 - the URL of the second image
      Returns:
      the comparison response containing confidence and thresholds
      Throws:
      IOException - if the HTTP request fails
      See Also:
      • FaceppApiAddress.FACE_COMPARE
